india_context.procedural_notes: Under Section 11 of the DPDP Act 2023, Data Principals have rights to access summaries of personal data, identities of third-party fiduciaries with whom data is shared, and correction/erasure.
india_context.transitional_notes: Grievance redressal officer contact details must be clearly provided with appellate escalation path to Data Protection Board of India.
verification_requirements: Ensure statutory record retention mandates under Income Tax Act and Companies Act are preserved.
